name: secaudit
description: Audits codebases for security vulnerabilities that AI coding assistants introduce in vibe-coded apps: exposed secrets, broken database access control (Supabase RLS, Firebase rules, Convex, Prisma tenant scoping), missing auth (Clerk, Better Auth), client-side trust, insecure payments (Stripe and mobile in-app purchase), object storage and presigned URLs, supply-chain risks, AI/LLM, RAG, MCP and agent risks, container hardening, and Expo / React Native / Python specifics. Whole-app audits fan out across parallel workers and rank findings by live advisory, exploitation-probability and end-of-life data.
